terminals.name: jupyter-lab
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && uv run --locked jupyter lab --no-browser --port 8888 --ip 127.0.0.1
terminals.description: Jupyter Lab with root project dependencies. Open the tokenized URL it prints inside the Cloud Agent environment. Nested projects and specialized notebooks need their documented extra setup. Live API cells need ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (and sometimes VOYAGE_API_KEY or other service credentials) as environment secrets.
